name: Amino acid metabolism via tyrosine, proline and glycine routes
rationale: All members are amino acid metabolic or catabolic processes; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from the organic-acid and threonine confusables, while proline, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism separate it from the phenylketonuria-centred confusable.

name: Transcriptional control of early myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members concern transcriptional regulation (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis) and restraint of granulocyte/monocyte/macrophage differentiation, and unlike the confusables they include myeloid progenitor proliferation and the promyelocyte programme rather than mature monocyte recruitment or neutrophil differentiation.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation with cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern chondrocyte development or cartilage/joint formation; embryonic joint and cartilage morphogenesis distinguish it from confusables carrying ossification, tendon or articular cartilage homeostasis.

name: Striated muscle calcium release control and cardiac relaxation
rationale: Members regulate release, sequestration and clearance of cytosolic calcium in cardiac and skeletal muscle, and unlike the confusables (SERCA/ATPase regulation, positive force and rate) they emphasise ryanodine-channel release control, sodium/calcium exchange and negative regulation of contraction and heart rate.

name: Melanocyte pigmentation, melanin synthesis and light response
rationale: All members concern MITF-M-driven melanocyte biology and pigmentation; melanin biosynthesis, pigment granule localisation, melanocyte proliferation and UV-A/blue-light responses distinguish it from confusables centred on MITF-M cell-cycle, senescence or melanosome assembly genes.

name: Cardiac muscle growth, hypertrophy and enhanced contractility
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, adaptation and survival, and positive regulation of contraction force and heart rate distinguishes it from the calcineurin/NFAT confusable, while the smooth-muscle confusables share nothing.

name: Adenylate cyclase cAMP production and PKA activation
rationale: All members concern stimulating cAMP synthesis (GPCR coupling, forskolin) and its PKA output, distinguishing it from the inhibitory-cyclase confusable and from confusables centred on CREB and cAMP degradation.

name: Ovarian follicle maturation, ovulation and luteal cycle
rationale: Members concern follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis, distinguishing it from confusables built on gonadotropin secretion and response.

name: Iminoglycinuria from defective proline-glycine transporters
rationale: All three members are transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria/hyperglycinuria, distinct from Hartnup, cystinuria, hexose and urate transport confusables.

core: ER protein targeting and membrane insertion
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP/tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER membrane and COPII cargo export toward Golgi; COPII export separates it from connexin-trafficking confusables, and multi-pass insertion separates it from COPI and ER-folding/ERAD confusables.

name: Embryonic craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of face, skull, palate, nose and limbs with mesenchymal development, distinguishing it from confusables involving pharyngeal-derived glands and ossification.

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
name: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production with cGAS-STING
rationale: Members concern innate cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production by dendritic cells, and cGAMP import/STING activation distinguishes it from the macrophage-chemokine and Th1 confusables, while CCL5/DC output distinguishes it from the TREX1/interferon-beta STING confusable.

core: Centrosome and microtubule organizing center positioning
name: Centrosome positioning and spindle orientation in asymmetric division
rationale: Members concern microtubule nucleation/anchoring at the centrosome and its localisation, and astral microtubules, spindle orientation and asymmetric division distinguish it from centriole-duplication, cytokinesis and mitotic centrosome-maturation confusables.

name: COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER vesicle targeting
rationale: Members concern COPI budding and vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, with COPI distinguishing it from tethering and COPII confusables.

name: Endosomal receptor recycling and vesicular cholesterol transport
rationale: Members concern endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and endosome organisation; the Golgi vesicle-traffic module and vesicle-mediated cholesterol transport distinguish it from the near-identical constitutive-secretion confusable, and recycling distinguishes it from Golgi-retrograde confusables.

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis and uptake defects
name: Retinol to retinoic acid metabolism and retinoid uptake defects
rationale: All members concern vitamin A/terpenoid metabolism, and retinoid disease events (STRA6 loss) distinguish it from confusables adding retinoic acid response or vitamin D, while retinoic acid synthesis distinguishes it from the visual-cycle confusable.

core: Plasma membrane amino acid and solute transport
name: Amino acid, peptide and urate transport and aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are solute carrier transport of amino acids, oligopeptides and urate with inherited aminoacidurias, distinguished by amino acid and peptide carriers from the organic-cation and hexose-transport confusables.

name: Myoblast differentiation restraint and skeletal muscle atrophy
rationale: Members concern negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation, satellite cell maintenance and disuse atrophy, distinguishing it from pro-myogenic, contractile and cardiac-hypertrophy confusables.

name: Glycogen metabolism and dietary sugar absorption disorders
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown with storage diseases plus intestinal hexose absorption and saccharidase defects; glycogen distinguishes it from hexose/urate and galactose confusables, absorption from glycolysis/gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: RUNX2- and Wnt-regulated osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation; RUNX2 regulation, Wnt antagonism and osteocyte mechanosignalling distinguish it from confusables centred on mineralization, osteoclasts, collagen or chondrocytes.

name: M-CSF signalling in macrophage proliferation and osteoclastogenesis
rationale: Members concern CSF1/interleukin receptor signalling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion into bone-resorbing osteoclasts; osteoclast members distinguish it from monocyte-differentiation confusables, CSF1 signalling from the DAP12 confusable.

name: Golgi ribbon dynamics and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi disassembly, reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning plus membrane tubulation, distinguishing it from secretory, COPI and Golgi-retention confusables.

name: Fibronectin-integrin adhesion and TGF-beta-linked fibroblast migration
rationale: Members concern integrin and fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion assembly and SRF cytoskeleton driving fibroblast migration; the collagen/TGF-beta module distinguishes it from syndecan and integrin-interaction confusables, adhesion from the EMT/YAP confusable.

name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern recycling from endosomes and constitutive secretory delivery to the plasma membrane, distinguishing it from confusables built on Golgi-endosome-lysosome retrograde traffic and Rab GAP regulation.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase, chiefly its inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic and G-alpha-z signalling, distinguishing it from PKA-activation, catecholamine-secretion and muscarinic/purinergic confusables.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance by recombination, t-circles, D-loop disassembly and capping, with break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and mitotic recombination resolution distinguishing it from confusables focused on telomere packaging, C-strand synthesis and fork reversal.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome system: linkage-specific ubiquitination and deubiquitination
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin chain synthesis, editing by DUB families and proteasome assembly/degradation; these distinguish it from neddylation/COP9 confusables and from misfolded-protein, ERAD and autophagy confusables.

qualifier: tubule patterning and nephric duct formation
name: Kidney nephron tubule patterning and nephric duct formation
rationale: All members concern metanephric/pronephric kidney development, and nephron segment differentiation (distal tubule, loop of Henle, S-shaped body) and nephric duct formation distinguish it from confusables centred on ureteric bud induction and kidney size.

name: Heme degradation and hepatic bilirubin clearance defects
rationale: Members concern heme catabolism and hepatic organic-anion uptake, conjugation and export of bilirubin with their hyperbilirubinemia defects, distinguishing it from drug ADME and xenobiotic-transport confusables.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC-Ib recognition
rationale: Members regulate NK and T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and activation, with MHC class Ib presentation and NK activation restraint distinguishing it from T-cell-proliferation confusables and NK receptor activation and tumour response distinguishing it from KIR/granzyme/tolerance confusables.
